feature_1_dashboard_month_filter.description: Dashboard date filter uses input type='month' (native month picker) instead of calendar component
feature_1_dashboard_month_filter.evidence: Found 2 month inputs with 'Filter by Month Range' label in filter panel. No calendar popup component rendered.

feature_2_facilities_no_delete.description: Facilities page has no delete button - only activate/deactivate toggle and edit buttons
feature_2_facilities_no_delete.evidence: Found 2 facility cards, 2 toggle buttons (Power/PowerOff icons), 2 edit buttons. 0 delete buttons or trash icons.

feature_3_emissions_alertdialog_delete.description: Emissions delete uses AlertDialog component (role='alertdialog') instead of browser confirm()
feature_3_emissions_alertdialog_delete.evidence: Clicking trash icon opens AlertDialog with 'Delete Emission Record' title, Cancel and Delete buttons, and emission details displayed.

feature_4_emissions_facility_first_messa.description: Add Emission form shows 'Please select a facility first' message when no facility selected
feature_4_emissions_facility_first_messa.evidence: Amber warning box with message appears in form. Category/fuel dropdowns not shown until facility selected.

feature_5_emissions_dropdowns_after_faci.description: Category and fuel type dropdowns only appear after facility is selected
feature_5_emissions_dropdowns_after_faci.evidence: Step 1: Select Category and Step 2: Select Fuel Type dropdowns become visible after facility selection.

feature_6_deactivated_facility_emissions.description: Emissions from deactivated facilities are hidden from the emissions list
feature_6_deactivated_facility_emissions.evidence: After deactivating test-1 facility, Emissions page shows 'No Scope 1 emissions' - all test-1 emissions hidden. Reactivating facility restores emissions visibility.
